bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
src=88fb602c82ef17baeb9b2878ae1e436c7e956eba
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/tgtumbler-gserver-deploy-20261106 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 72; }
d="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-stk04-pinv2.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
git archive "$src" | tar -xf - -C "$d"
test -f "$d/artifacts/bot/scripts/ensureStickerTopicPin.ts" || exit 73
podman build --quiet --file "$d/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" --tag localhost/gace-stk04-pin:88fb602c "$d" >/dev/null || exit 74
podman image inspect localhost/gace-stk04-pin:88fb602c >/dev/null || exit 75
echo STK04_GSERVER_PIN_IMAGE_BUILD_PASS
